label: Main Product
purpose: Main product information section with all product blocks
_notes: This is the main product section that appears on all product pages. Essential blocks: product_title, product_price, product_product-variant-picker-block, product_buy-buttons, product_description. Blocks are displayed in the order specified in block_order array. Typical order: award_badge → review-avatars → title → price → rating-stars OR product-rating → description → variant_picker → quantity_selector → buy_buttons → shipping_checkpoints → payment-badges → product_tabs OR collapsible-row → share. Use EXACT block names as listed in allowed_blocks above, copied verbatim (hyphens vs underscores matter): 'rating-stars' NOT 'rating_stars', 'payment-badges' NOT 'payment_badges', 'icon-with-text' NOT 'icon_with_text', 'text-with-icon' NOT 'text_with_icon', 'atc-button' NOT 'atc_button', 'media-slider' NOT 'media_slider', 'countdown-timer' NOT 'countdown_timer', 'custom-liquid' NOT 'custom_liquid', 'product_tabs' NOT 'tab', 'collapsible-row' NOT 'accordion', 'product-rating' for product ratings.
